surface: Independent live local Chrome browser preview

revision.note: The inspected UI did not expose a verified code revision. These fresh UI observations are separate from the pinned source and released-package reports.

observations.detail: On entry Red was in the roster and selected; Falka/Mimi, Leo and Thor were not in the roster; No figure was explicit; all Available online controls were disabled.
Unchecking Red selected No figure and disabled Red selection. Reload retained No figure. Start match opened a figure-free local table; Ready advanced Tick 1 through resolving to Tick 2.

Falka, Leo and Thor were individually enabled and selected through the actual setup controls. All three visibly rendered at the opponent seat with their own nameplate. Leo and Thor advanced Tick 1 to Tick 2 with Ready.
Falka Who is playing identified avatar-8, falka-human-assisted 2026-11-17.1, human-connected-forward-mesh-r1, heuristic-bot/0.2.0 and captions-only/no voice. It incorrectly said via Harbor.

Red was restored and visibly rendered at the table. Who is playing identified red-reaper, red-pose-art 2026-11-02.1 and red-pose-art-speech-v2-idle-v2 via Harbor; the details reported its Voice Card. No independent audio-quality claim.

At this viewport setup rows, Details, Start match, table/nameplate and Ready were usable. Short rendering/turn observations only: no animation performance benchmark, long-session soak or human aesthetic acceptance.

All five radio controls exposed the same accessible name Play this game, and the four roster checkboxes the same name In my roster. Include Avatar-specific accessible names in the small label follow-up.
Error-log reads returned [] at the two inspected points (after Thor rendering and after the final setup reload). This is not an assertion that every possible journey is error-free.
